WITH target AS (
    SELECT customer_id, customer_name, region, email
    FROM {{ source('legacy', 'customers') }}
),
staging AS (
    SELECT customer_id, customer_name, region, email
    FROM {{ source('legacy', 'customer_staging') }}
),
matched AS (
    SELECT
        t.customer_id,
        s.customer_name,
        s.region,
        COALESCE(s.email, t.email) AS email
    FROM target t
    INNER JOIN staging s
        ON t.customer_id = s.customer_id
),
unmatched_target AS (
    SELECT t.customer_id, t.customer_name, t.region, t.email
    FROM target t
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM staging s WHERE s.customer_id = t.customer_id
    )
),
inserted AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id, s.customer_name, s.region, s.email
    FROM staging s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM target t WHERE t.customer_id = s.customer_id
    )
)
SELECT customer_id, customer_name, region, email FROM matched
UNION ALL
SELECT customer_id, customer_name, region, email FROM unmatched_target
UNION ALL
SELECT customer_id, customer_name, region, email FROM inserted

explanation: This procedure keeps a customer dimension in sync with a staging feed. It starts from the current customers table, overwrites name and region for customers that appear in staging (and fills in email from staging, keeping the existing email when staging has none), and adds any staging customers not already present. Customers absent from staging are left unchanged, and nothing is deleted.
